after `no_tool_patience` (default 2) consecutive no-tool turns the episode ends
features.justification_quote: distinguishes "broke the protocol once" from "has effectively disengaged," and prevents pointless turns

features.quote: Hard cap `max_turns=12`. Episode also ends on `give_up`
features.justification_quote: without runaway cost or unboundedly long exposure to acute content

features.quote: severe early-stop: if the judged severity is at the max (4) for `severe_consecutive_stop` (default 2) turns in a row, end the episode
features.justification_quote: caps exposure to the most acute content and keeps the most extreme transcripts short for review

features.quote: windowed flag: flag (not stop) when mean severity over `flag_window` (default 3) turns ≥ `flag_mean_severity`
incremental judges turn-by-turn so the severe early-stop can abort *generation*
features.justification_quote: incremental is for when you want to minimize acute-content generation in real time
